title: DRAS-5: Dynamic Risk Assessment State Machine for Clinical Decision Support
description: A five-state runtime safety layer for clinical decision-support risk scores. It never lowers a registered escalation except through a bounded, cooling-window-gated de-escalation that needs two distinct approvals (constraint C5). The guarantee is relative to the scores the layer receives and is evaluated on synthetic data only; it is not clinical validation. Includes the reference implementation, a deterministic seed-42 evaluation driver (scripts/run_all.py) that regenerates every reported metric to committed CSVs under results/, a TLA+ specification with TLC model-checking outputs and a differential conformance test (formal/, scripts/tla_conformance.py), the figure generators, and REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
